question: What Do You Think About Car?

answers.text: I've always wanted a big truck, 4x4 so I could go anywhere I wanted
It makes the work easier by traveling to work
Cars are good, they make life easy but in order to have a car, you have to have money So right now, I don't have a car, but I’m praying to have one
I think cars are okay giving [me] a job
I have two trucks at home It’s better for me to just walk getting fit and take a walk
The only problem is just causes too much pollution over here The city life, it’s all changing with all the air that comes out of the back of the car
Ooh, the cars here in Fiji is... Oh, so many... Plenty. Like in the morning when we came Oh, plenty!
Yeah. Too many cars here Right? In the roads So the cars theres a lot of traffic

My mom has a Hyundai Sonata. It's a very old car, but it does the job I like the fact that it's a luxury car Yeah, it's it's spacious. It's big. I love cars, actually we are getting into the car business My family and I
There are too many in the morning/afternoon There's a lot of traffic, so we have to leave our home early In the afternoon, same We have to be in the traffic for more than one hour.
Too many cars in Fiji -Why is that? -Why is there so many cars?
because of our last government Cars were imported so much and everybody wants a car
Like if there is three cars, you can just use one But everybody likes to drive thier own car I suppose
